handEdits: Hand edit needed in snippets/review_leaflet.md, body: the body's if at line 1 decides what a macro body shows, which has no parts; write each text as a snippet with its own if, placed where the text was.

Hand edit needed in snippets/visit_echo.md, body: macro 'new_visit_note' is read as fixed text at line 1, but it is offered under a condition or placed by the engine; place its text as a snippet with an if.
Hand edit needed in macros/quoted_review.md, body: the template reads deliverable.review_summary.content at line 1, which a 31 macro body doesn't read; rewrite it.
Hand edit needed in macros/section_intro.md, instruction: macro 'section_intro' was placed before the reply by the engine; say in its instruction where the model writes its marker.
Hand edit needed in macros/section_close.md, instruction: macro 'section_close' was placed after the reply by the engine; say in its instruction where the model writes its marker.
Hand edit needed in deliverables/gated.md, body: macro 'new_visit_note' is placed on this deliverable with a condition; place its text as a snippet with an if, or write the condition in the template.
Hand edit needed in deliverables/gated.md, body: macro 'review_note' is placed on this deliverable with a condition; place its text as a snippet with an if, or write the condition in the template.

Hand edit needed in deliverables/optional.md, body: macro 'followup_offer' is placed on this deliverable with a condition; place its text as a snippet with an if, or write the condition in the template.

Hand edit needed in deliverables/optional.md, body: macro 'leaflet_offer' is placed on this deliverable with a condition; place its text as a snippet with an if, or write the condition in the template.
Hand edit needed in deliverables/echoes.md, body: macro 'quoted_review' is placed on this deliverable with a condition; place its text as a snippet with an if, or write the condition in the template.
notices: macros/section_close.md, if: 'item.value.title ≠ "Plan"' became not (trim(item.value.title) in ["Plan"]); text is compared with a literal by in at 31, and an input's text is trimmed at both ends first, where 30 trimmed its end.
Macro 'followup_offer' is now offered by the input 'followup_offer'.
Macro 'leaflet_offer' is now offered by the input 'leaflet_offer'.
The signature is written through renderer 'signature_after_line_end', which leaves it and the line before it out when the signature is blank, as specVersion 30 did.
Macro 'quoted_review' is now offered by the input 'quoted_review'.
The signature is written through renderer 'signature_after_blank_line', which leaves it and the line before it out when the signature is blank, as specVersion 30 did.
Loop 'section_loop' returns each item through the new node 'section_draft_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
In 'snippets/body_echo.md', the read node.letter_body.content now starts its own line, after a blank line: at specVersion 31 a markdown_block read stands alone on its line.
No snapshot test was written: hand edits remain.
Each deliverable is now delivered by pdf in a message of its own, where 30 sent one message for the job.

texts.explanation: before-after-macro-marker: a macro 30's engine placed before or after a node's reply is a marker at 31: the placing prompt holds its instruction, and its body stands where the model wrote the marker, so only the white space between the body and the reply differs, where 30 joined them by a blank line (#1508, comment 5, item 7, #10, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25; part 05 § 10; part 10 §§ 1.4, 3.2)
